summary.en: The Colombian army carried out an air strike that killed eight members of the Gulf Clan gang, while cocaine-linked militias have begun using Ukraine-style drones in attacks. Venezuela and Colombia have launched a joint border security operation after a series of kidnappings. A court sentenced five former soldiers to reparations work for executions, and a Colombian accused by the United States of trafficking cocaine and supporting FARC dissidents remains under investigation. The conflict recorded 225 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Den colombianske hæren utførte et luftangrep som drepte åtte medlemmer av gjengklanen Gulf Clan, mens militsgrupper knyttet til kokain har begynt å bruke droner i ukrainsk stil i angrep. Venezuela og Colombia har igangsatt en felles grenseoperasjon etter en rekke kidnappinger. En domstol dømte fem tidligere soldater til reparasjonsarbeid for henrettelser, og en colombianer som er anklaget av USA for narkotikasmugling og støtte til FARC-dissidenter, er fortsatt under etterforskning. Konflikten registrerte 225 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Colombian conflict
background.extract: The Colombian conflict began on May 27, 1964, and is a low-intensity asymmetric war between the government of Colombia, paramilitary groups, crime syndicates, and far-left guerrilla groups engaged in armed factional hostilities to increase their influence in Colombian territory. Some of the most important international contributors to the Colombian conflict include multinational corporations, the United States, Cuba, and the drug trafficking industry.
